2119744600894058722.en_summary: US stocks rose pre-market (SPX +0.4%, NDX +0.3%) as Brent crude fell 1.1% to $97/bbl on Trump’s more conciliatory Iran comments, offsetting $NVDA’s -4.4% drop after CEO Jensen Huang admitted an extended affair with a suspected Chinese spy; board investigating but sees no secrets or national security compromised. Chip demand expected to exceed supply for years, $NVDA 2027 P/E 19x compelling. Easing energy prices and strong S&P 2026 EPS growth (+33% YoY) implying 20x P/E should support equities. Remains cautious on $TSLA due to stretched valuation, negative earnings revisions, and commoditization of autonomous tech.
2119744600894058722.zh_summary: 美股盤前上漲（SPX +0.4%、NDX +0.3%），因特朗普對伊朗較為和解的言論令布倫特原油下跌1.1%至97美元/桶，抵消了NVDA因執行長黃仁勳承認與一名疑似中國間諜有長期婚外情而下跌4.4%的影響；董事會正在調查，但認為未洩露公司機密或危害國家安全。晶片需求預計未來數年將超過供應，NVDA 2027年市盈率19倍具吸引力。能源價格回落及標普2026年盈利增長強勁（同比+33%）意味著20倍市盈率，應支持股市。對TSLA保持謹慎，因其估值偏高、盈利下修及自動駕駛技術商品化。
